title: Request about my data
description: Send a request concerning your own account and personal data to the workspace operator.
summary: What would you like us to review?
guidance: Describe the request without passwords, verification codes or other secrets. Account closure and personal-data erasure are separate requests.
receivedDescription: Your request was recorded. This does not mean that data was changed or deleted.
accountChanged: Your signed-in account changed. The draft was cleared. Reload to start a request for the current account.

errors.csrf_rejected: The security check failed. Retry this request. If it still fails, ask the workspace operator for help.
errors.fresh_auth_required: Confirm your identity, then explicitly retry the same request. Your draft is preserved.
errors.request_failed: Receipt is not confirmed. Retry the same request; do not create another one.
errors.invalid_input: Enter a request of 1 to 4,000 characters.
errors.forbidden: This request is not currently permitted. Retry after your access is restored.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This retry does not match its original request. Ask the workspace operator for help.
errors.storage_unavailable: Receipt is not confirmed. Retry the same request; do not create another one.
errors.stale_version: The request changed. Refresh its status before continuing.
errors.evidence_unavailable: The verification evidence is unavailable. Ask the workspace operator for help.
errors.case_not_mutable: This request can no longer be changed.
errors.requester_changed: Your signed-in account changed. The draft was cleared. Reload to start a request for the current account.
errors.transport_interrupted: The connection was interrupted and receipt is not confirmed. Retry the same request.

workspaceDescription: Send a request about your own data. A received request does not automatically change or erase data.
workspaceUnavailable: Sign-in status is unavailable. Try again.
workspaceSecurityTab: Account security in a new tab
workspaceSecurityTabHelp: Confirm your identity there, then return and explicitly retry here. Your draft stays in this tab.
caseWorkspaceDescription: Follow a request about your own data. Status does not mean that data has been changed or erased.
caseDescription: Current status of a request about your own account. This does not approve disclosure or a data change.
caseLoadFailed: Request status could not be loaded. Try again.
caseNotLoaded: Refresh to load the current request status.
caseConfirm: Confirm this request concerns my own account
caseConfirmHelp: This records an own-account confirmation for this request only. It does not approve disclosure, deletion or a response.
caseConfirmationPending: It is unclear whether your account confirmation was recorded. Retry the same confirmation; do not start another one.
caseConfirmationRecorded: Your own-account confirmation was recorded. This does not approve a response or data change.
caseFreshRequired: Confirm your identity, then explicitly retry here.
caseChanged: The request changed. Refresh its status before starting another confirmation.
caseConflict: This retry does not match your original confirmation. Ask the workspace operator for help.
caseAccountChanged: Your signed-in account changed. Reload to continue with the current account.
